Sensitivity: material term changes (limit, deductible or premium moving more than the agreed tolerance from the quote) require re-confirmation and re-rating rather than a straight confirmation.

Materiality threshold for correction = any premium variance above the documented rounding tolerance or any coverage-term difference from the accepted quote; below-threshold differences noted, above-threshold reworked.

Policy-of-record values reconcile to the bound quote and the billing feed: premium on the policy = bound premium = amount transmitted to billing; delta 0 before issuance completes.

Sampled policy records trace to the bound quote and the accepted terms in OpenText; coverages and premium on the record match the source.

Effective and expiry dates on the record match the bound term and the confirmation; creation date on or before the effective date, validated at issuance.

Bind confirmation with effective date/time stored to OpenText under /Underwriting/Binding/<policy-number>/ with timestamp and version; PolicyCenter retains the immutable bind transaction record.

Sampled bind transactions trace to the authorization record and the accepted quote; effective date/time and terms match the source.
Policy status transitions to Bound/In-Force at bind, consistent with the authorization; no bind recorded on an unauthorized transaction.
Recorded effective date/time is validated against the quote validity window and the authorization timestamp; bind timestamp is on or after authorization.

answers.value: The binder or evidence of insurance issued on a bound risk — the interim proof of coverage stating insured, coverage, limits and effective date pending the full policy. Scope = one bound risk (single policy number).
From bind until the policy is issued (binder validity typically capped, e.g. 30–60 days); the binder carries the policy effective date and its own expiry.

Binder states named insured, insurer, coverage, limits/deductibles, effective date, binder expiry, and any subjectivities; it uses current filed forms. The binder cannot issue while a mandatory field is blank or a form is out of filing.

Materiality: coverage-term differences or premium variance above rounding tolerance between binder and bound record are material and trigger reissue.
Sampled binders trace to the bound PolicyCenter transaction and the filed form set; stated terms match the source record.

Binder effective date matches the bound inception; binder expiry set within the allowed maximum and validated at issue.

answers.value: Locking the bound transaction from further edits — setting the PolicyCenter transaction to a committed/read-only state so the bound terms and effective date/time are immutable. Scope = one bound transaction (single policy number).
Immediately after bind, within the policy's effective period; the lock is applied once the bind transaction is committed.

Transaction shows status Bound/Committed, lock flag set, locking user and timestamp captured; no editable coverage or premium field remains open. Post-lock changes must go through an endorsement, not a direct edit.
Locked values equal the authorized/bound values (premium, limits, effective date/time); a post-lock recheck confirms 0 unauthorized changes between bind and lock.
Lock event (user, timestamp, transaction ID) memorialized in the GRC platform and retained in the PolicyCenter transaction log; retained 7 years for change-control audit.
Attempts to edit a locked transaction are blocked and logged as exceptions requiring an endorsement path; unlock requests (rare) require Senior Underwriter approval with documented reason.

Status = Bound/Committed with the lock flag set; no locked transaction remains in an editable state.
Lock timestamp is on or after the bind timestamp; effective date/time carried unchanged into the locked record, validated at lock.
Pre/post check: transaction field values immediately before lock vs the committed bound values confirm no unauthorized change; the comparison is stored with the transaction.
The PolicyCenter lock activity ID is the change reference; any later change is linked as a separate endorsement transaction, never a silent edit.
Test population = transactions locked in the review month; QA samples 5% (minimum 10) to confirm immutability and value integrity.

PASS = transaction is read-only post-lock, locked values equal bound values, and any change went through an endorsement. FAIL = an editable locked record, a value change without an endorsement, or a missing lock timestamp.
On FAIL, restore the bound values, route any needed change through an endorsement, log the control breach, and remediate within 5 business days; systemic lock failures raised to PAS support.

Materiality: a premium difference between policy and invoice above the rounding tolerance, or an installment schedule that does not sum to premium, is material and blocks invoicing.

answers.value: The notification to policy administration to begin policy document generation and system set-up on a bound risk. Scope = one bound policy handed to policy admin for issuance.
Immediately after bind, within the policy's effective term; the hand-off occurs once the bound terms and effective date/time are committed.

Hand-off carries policy number, insured, coverages, limits, endorsement forms, effective/expiry dates and any subjectivities; policy admin cannot start generation while a mandatory field or form is missing.
Terms in the issuance hand-off reconcile to the bound record; coverages, forms and dates handed to policy admin = bound values, delta 0.
Issuance hand-off record and confirmation stored to OpenText under /Underwriting/Issuance/<policy-number>/ with timestamp and version; PolicyCenter retains the transaction history.

Hand-offs with missing forms or open subjectivities logged as exceptions with disposition (obtain form / clear subjectivity / hold issuance), owner = Underwriter; unresolved holds escalate to Senior Underwriter.
The document set to be generated uses current filed forms and the approved Earnix rating version behind the bound premium; both versions are referenced on the hand-off.
Sensitivity: any post-bind change to coverage or forms before issuance requires an updated hand-off so policy admin generates the correct document set.
Materiality: a coverage/form difference or premium variance above rounding tolerance between the hand-off and the bound record is material and holds issuance until corrected.
Sampled issuance hand-offs trace to the bound PolicyCenter transaction and the filed form set; handed terms match the source record.
Policy status = Bound before the issuance hand-off is sent; policy admin is not notified on unbound quotes.
Effective/expiry dates in the hand-off match the bound term; hand-off date on or after bind, validated before notification.
Test population = policies handed to policy admin for issuance in the review month; QA samples 5% (minimum 10) for completeness and accuracy.
PASS = hand-off carries complete, correct terms and current forms matching the bound record with no open mandatory subjectivity. FAIL = missing form, term mismatch, or open mandatory subjectivity.
On FAIL, correct and re-send the hand-off, log the defect, and remediate within 5 business days; recurring hand-off gaps raised to the UW operations lead.
Source-system field definitions from PolicyCenter: policy_number, coverage_code, form_id, effective_date, expiry_date, subjectivity_status handed to policy admin.
Control total = count of bound policies handed to policy admin reconciles to the issuance queue; each hand-off ties 1:1 to a bound PolicyCenter transaction.

Approved methodology/model version and parameter source = the current filed form editions and the approved Earnix rating version behind the bound premium; both version references are carried on the issuance hand-off for the generated document set.

checklist.step: Document the issuance hand-off
checklist.value: The hand-off record and any supporting forms are imaged and linked to the policy before generation starts.

testing.value: Monthly 5% sample shows a filed issuance hand-off; 0 gaps.

checklist.step: Document the issuance decision within 24 hours
checklist.value: The notification to policy admin, with terms and effective dates, is recorded within 24 hours of bind.

testing.value: Sampled bound policies show the issuance hand-off recorded within 24 hours; 0 late/undocumented hand-offs.

checklist.step: Hand off only current filed forms for generation
checklist.value: The form set specified for issuance uses current filed editions for the state and product.

testing.value: Sampled hand-offs specify current filed form editions; 0 out-of-filing forms sent for generation.

checklist.step: Confirm OFAC screening cleared before initiating issuance
checklist.value: Named insured and additional parties screened against OFAC SDN and consolidated lists at onboarding; a clear result gates the issuance hand-off.

testing.value: 100% of issuance hand-offs show a cleared OFAC screen dated on or before the hand-off; hits block issuance and trigger sanctions review.
